qualification.details: Guest Instructor (Surveyor): B.Voc./Degree in Survey/Civil Engineering from an AICTE/UGC recognized Institution with 01 year relevant experience OR 03-year Diploma in Survey/Civil Engineering from an AICTE recognized Board with 02 years relevant experience OR NTC/NAC in Surveyor Trade with 03 years relevant experience. Preference: Candidates possessing relevant National Craft Instructor Certificate (NCIC) under DGT. Guest Instructor (Mechanic Electric Vehicle - MEV): B.Voc./Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 01 year relevant experience OR 03-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 02 years relevant experience OR NTC/NAC in Mechanic Electric Vehicle Trade with 03 years relevant experience. Essential: NCIC (relevant variant) and valid LMV Driving Licence. Guest Instructor (Mechanic Motor Vehicle - MMV): B.Voc./Degree in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering with 01 year relevant experience OR 03-year Diploma in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering with 02 years relevant experience OR NTC/NAC in Mechanic Motor Vehicle Trade with 03 years relevant experience. Essential: NCIC (relevant variant) and valid LMV Driving Licence. Guest Instructor (Electrician): B.Voc./Degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 01 year relevant experience OR 03-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 02 years relevant experience OR NTC/NAC in Electrician Trade with 03 years relevant experience. Preference: Candidates possessing relevant NCIC under DGT.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ITI Bhanjanagar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ITI Bhanjanagar?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Instructor posts at ITI Bhanjanagar is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Eligibility varies by post but generally includes B.Voc/Degree/Diploma/NTC/NAC in the relevant trade with experience. Specific qualifications for Surveyor, Mechanic Electric Vehicle, Mechanic Motor Vehicle, and Electrician are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for ITI Bhanjanagar recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these Guest Instructor positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Instructor positions at ITI Bhanjanagar will involve a Written Test, Practical Test, Micro Teaching, and Viva-Voce.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Guest Instructor positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Instructor positions at ITI Bhanjanagar are on a Part-Time basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ITI Bhanjanagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ITI Bhanjanagar office. The exact address and reporting time are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations mentioned?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age limits or relaxations. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed information regarding age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for the Guest Instructor positions at Industrial Training Institute Bhanjanagar.
